bundle.shortDescription: Physical media launch keys for Windows PC games.
bundle.longDescription: MediaDeck turns floppy disks, CDs, and DVDs into collectible launch keys. Media stores only a bounded GAME.INI manifest; games stay installed normally on the PC. Includes tray monitoring, optional per-user autostart, label export, diagnostics, and verified backup.
